name: Azure AI Vision
tagline: Cloud image analysis, OCR, and spatial analysis via Azure Cognitive Services
description: Azure AI Vision (Computer Vision) provides REST APIs for image analysis, optical character recognition (OCR/Read), object detection, image tagging, and related vision capabilities. Developers call a regional Cognitive Services resource endpoint with a subscription key or Microsoft Entra token. Face-related features may require separate Face API access; product branding has consolidated under Azure AI Vision / Azure AI Services.

auth.details: Subscription key via Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key header (or query key), or Microsoft Entra ID bearer token; create a Vision/Cognitive Services resource in Azure Portal.

example.response_snippet: {"description":{"tags":["text","person"],"captions":[{"text":"a person standing in front of a screen","confidence":0.9}]},"requestId":"...","metadata":{"width":1038,"height":692,"format":"Jpeg"}}

use_cases: extract text from images or PDFs with OCR
generate image captions and tags for accessibility
detect objects and brands in product photos
analyze image color and adult content flags
read handwritten or printed documents at scale
